images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a long dark hall ending in one narrow brightly lit gate, a long orderly queue of identical crates waiting to pass through, and one small red crate being waved through ahead of all the others. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette filling most of the frame, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights used sparingly, thin red (#eb2027) accent lines only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: the scene fills the entire frame corner to corner, no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame, no empty background field. No text, no numbers, no letters, no labels, no writing, no logos anywhere in the image.
